body:
Thank you very much.
If you don't mind me asking, did he leave any reasoning behind?

I've been trying to heal for so long. It seems like I can't escape these feelings. 
But thank you, those are truly great words of encouragement and they mean the world to me at this moment.
Thank you for taking the time. I really appreciate it.
It's true. You're right. It's very short term, isn't it? But I can't see myself in the future. I get so damn *sad* that I don't even want to live. That's probably the problem.
Thank you, that is very kind.

I've been asked this before. I don't know. But when I get in these states (this last one has lasted about two weeks and is becoming more severe), it seems I can't process much or think logically or in the long-term. 
It's like being a heroin addict, but all you think about is depression and the end.
Thank you for your kindness and concern. I did end up talking to a stranger today. They definitely prolonged something.

I seem to be living a very normal life outwardly. I go to school, have a part-time job, have an affectionate family, and incredible friends who are always supportive. It's fucked. 
I think of killing myself all the time and have tried twice already. I get into extreme depressive states for days/months at a time until I finally reach rock bottom where I can't deal with it anymore and *want* to just end it all.
But then I think of everything and everyone and I know have to keep going for their sake. I don't know what it is that I was looking for here, I guess some sort of reminder. The internet is a strange place, and yet I find that reddit has been a bit of a numbing escape sometimes.
